plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Loop Telecom AM3440 access multiplexers (L-AM3440-A-Private, enterprise PEN 823). It reports uptime, estimated power consumption, controller temperature and relative humidity, power card and fan status, and interface traffic.
name: Access

metrics.name: power_consumption_watts
metrics.description: Estimated total (maximum) power consumption of the Loop Telecom AM3440 chassis in watts, from powerConsumption (L-AM3440-A-Private, 1.3.6.1.4.1.823.34441.1.10.5.0). Values outside 1-5000 W are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature reported by each AM3440 controller card in degrees Celsius, parsed from the leading number of the c1Temperature / c2Temperature text (1.3.6.1.4.1.823.34441.1.10.11.0 / .13.0). Empty, non-numeric, zero and out-of-range readings are dropped.

metrics.name: device_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Relative humidity reported by each AM3440 controller card in percent, parsed from the leading number of the c1RelativeHumidity / c2RelativeHumidity text (1.3.6.1.4.1.823.34441.1.10.12.0 / .14.0). Empty, non-numeric, zero and out-of-range readings are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Status of each AM3440 power card from power1Status / power2Status (1.3.6.1.4.1.823.34441.1.10.3.0 / .4.0): dc-100w, dc-150w, ac and dc-125v map to 1, off and fail map to 2. Cards reported as not present (power1AC / power2AC none, or status none) are skipped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Status of each AM3440 fan from fan1Status / fan2Status (1.3.6.1.4.1.823.34441.1.10.6.0 / .7.0): good maps to 1 and fail-or-not-exist maps to 2.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
